list.title: Gyms
list.intro: View gym catalog entries and their status.
list.error: Could not load gyms. Please try again.
list.empty: No gyms have been added yet.
list.filteredEmpty: No gyms match these filters. Try another name or location.

form.loadError: Could not load this gym. Please try again.
form.saveError: Could not save this gym. Your changes are still here.
form.notFound: This gym is unavailable or its link is invalid.
form.validationSummary: Check the highlighted fields before saving.

basic.title: Basic Information
basic.name: Gym name
basic.descriptionHelper: Optional. Enter 5–2,000 characters, or leave blank.
basic.phoneHelper: Optional. Include 7–15 digits; spaces, parentheses, hyphens and a leading + are allowed.

photos.empty: Choose photos that show the gym and its training spaces.
photos.malformed: The upload returned invalid photo data. Your existing photos are unchanged.
photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Add 1–5 photos. The first photo is the cover.
photos.minimum: Add at least one gym photo.
photos.maximum: A gym can have up to five photos.
photos.invalidPath: Use uploaded gym photos. External image URLs are not accepted.
photos.fileType: Choose JPEG, PNG or WebP images.
photos.size: Each image must be 5 MiB or smaller.
photos.error: Could not upload the photos. Your existing photos are unchanged.

hours.draftHelp: Enter both times for each open day, or mark it closed.
hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.unknown: Opening hours have not been supplied.
hours.sevenDays: Include each weekday exactly once and choose whether it is open or closed.
hours.requiredTimes: Enter both opening and closing times for each open day.
hours.timeOrder: Closing time must be later than opening time on the same day.
hours.note: Informational gym hours in Asia/Seoul time. These do not set trainer booking availability. Overnight hours and multiple intervals are not supported.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.createdPaused: New gyms are saved as paused. Review the details before publishing.
lifecycle.confirmBody: This permanently closes editing and removes the gym from public discovery. It does not physically delete the record or cancel existing reservations. Unsaved changes will not be saved.
lifecycle.terminal: This gym is deleted and can only be viewed. It cannot be edited or restored.
lifecycle.visibilityNote: Pausing or deleting a gym hides its linked programs and prevents new bookings. Existing reservations remain unchanged.

conflict.stale: Another administrator changed this gym. Your draft is preserved. Reload the latest details before saving again.
conflict.busy: The gym changed during this request. Your draft is preserved. Reload the latest details before saving again.
conflict.discardWarning: Reloading replaces your current draft with the latest saved details.
conflict.unknown: The save result could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved. Reload and check the saved details before trying again.
conflict.unknownCreate: The creation result could not be confirmed. Check the gym list before creating it again to avoid a duplicate.

venue.referenced: This gym is already used by programs. Its location and address cannot be changed.
venue.helper: Once any program references a gym, its location and address are protected, including spelling corrections.

auth.forbidden: An active administrator account is required.
auth.session: Your administrator session could not be confirmed. Please sign in again.

validation.name: Enter a gym name with 3–100 characters after trimming spaces.
validation.address: Enter an address with 3–100 characters after trimming spaces.
validation.description: Enter 5–2,000 characters for the description, or leave it blank.
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number with 7–15 digits and no more than 25 characters, or leave it blank.
